lines.text: Many learners say: I prefer tea than coffee.
Better: I prefer tea to coffee.
To! I prefer rice to bread.

native.tip: Kita bilang “lebih suka teh daripada kopi”, tapi dengan prefer, bahasa Inggris pakai to, bukan than.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I prefer tea than coffee.” 😅 Dengan prefer, pakai to: “I prefer tea to coffee.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “to”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang makanan favoritmu dengan prefer … to. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “lebih suka teh daripada kopi”, but with prefer, English uses to, not than.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I prefer tea than coffee.” 😅 With prefer, use to: “I prefer tea to coffee.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
